paragraphs.text: Crephas was the Felonarch of Inys Nohr , and direct descendant of Nohr .

Crephas was known to hunt elves with an ancient longbow. He succeeded his father as Felonarch while he was still alive. It was rumored that he had killed all of his brothers and sisters to secure his throne. During his time as Felonarch, he became obsessed with experimenting with the broken leyline of the Clan Tree of Cridhe , using it to mutate the inhabitants of Nohrland. Crephas killed and was killed by his father after they both went insane from the Curse around 3553 AR .

Modifying the taste and effects of the ardré fungus to make himself less sensitive to cold. He eventually created the Mirkalbion people who were addicted to the plant and served as slaves in the region's coal mines.
Creating the lumini fireflies, which provided light to Loch Prith
Creating shrouds while attempting to make an invisible cloak using Haenish lint and Inys Nohr's moat water
The frog , a human horrifically mutated to be froglike
Portis , an elf whose skin turned green and whose hair turned into leaves
Ruka , a human who was given moth wings
A human man who had the face and claws of a rock lizard
A human man with no eyes and lips that looked like an orchid’s petals
